races.paceDynamic: Monk's Hill will be alone on the lead in a race where six horses want prominent positions, creating traffic congestion behind the sole front runner. The Floors Munky, Miss Magic Dragon, Hares Bredth, Woody Y Fernandez, Brain Freeze and Kwidsin will jostle for position in the pack, while nine hold-up horses including Powernap, Ganthorpe and Noble Gentleman will be forced wide or caught in traffic 2-3 furlongs out. With Monk's Hill setting uncontested fractions and the prominent brigade creating a wall of horses, this race shape strongly favours either the lone leader or patient hold-up horses who can find racing room late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Monk's Hill gets easy fractions on the front end without pressure.
scenarios.body: The lone leader builds a decisive advantage while the prominent pack battles behind, then kicks clear when the hold-up horses are still organizing their challenge. This scenario rewards the horse with the clearest trip and tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates enough pace and traffic problems to set up a closer.
scenarios.body: Patient hold-up horses like Miss Magic Dragon and Powernap benefit from the early pace battle, finding clear runs while the prominent brigade weakens after their mid-race jostle. The pace collapses late allowing fresh finishers to sweep past.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Survivor Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure the ideal stalking position without getting caught in traffic.
scenarios.body: A horse like Hares Bredth or Brain Freeze gets the perfect trip tracking Monk's Hill, avoids the worst of the mid-pack scrimmaging, then has enough left to collar the leader. This requires tactical luck and a strong finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Monk's Hill sets very slow fractions and the prominent pack fails to apply pressure.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2-furlong pole with no true pace set up front, allowing a horse with tactical speed like Long Shot or Dream Forever to quicken decisively. This scenario requires the pace to completely fall apart early.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems in the prominent pack 2-3 furlongs out as six horses fight for limited racing room behind Monk's Hill
Monitor if Monk's Hill gets uncontested lead fractions as this significantly increases his winning chances
Keep eye on Miss Magic Dragon's position turning for home as she needs to avoid the worst traffic to utilize her recent winning form
Watch for late moves from Powernap and Ganthorpe if genuine pace develops, both need strong gallop to be effective
Check if Long Shot can overcome his tendency to fade by getting better trip than usual in hold-up role
